body:
Having taken my fair share of entheogens as well as what I would term as pyshocative but without that well-known, ubiquitous love and just that 'welcome back/home'... I suppose the easiest explanation is there are substances that have a narcotic/escapist almost lonely feeling to them, though even some narcotics, though with extreme prejudice and a little bit of luck and well perhaps just plugging into the entheo energy.
This is really a fast description explaining how MET can very much get me straight up next to DMT, though there may be some slight differences, to be honest, the length of the experience, the dosage amounts, are all very similar....
the length of the experience, the dosage amounts, are all very similar....
If I was blindfolded and was asked to take a low-mid strength vape of DMT versus MET, the only give away would have been the absolutely noxious DMT fumes, which MET seems not to have.
So yes, my take away from this is MET is more easily vaped, and therefore more easily accessible to the masses.
